compute_scaling_factors: compute model scaling factors for depth, width, groups, and resolution using a scale type string and scale factor
scale_model_anynet: scale an AnyNet model by adjusting depths, widths, bottleneck multipliers, and group widths based on config scaling settings
scale_model_effnet: scale an EfficientNet model by adjusting depths, widths, expansion ratios, stem width, and head width based on config scaling settings
scale_model_regnet: scale a RegNet model by first converting to AnyNet config then applying depth, width, and group scaling factors
review_scaling_factors: review the scaling_factors function to understand how scale type strings like d1_w8_g8_r1 map to depth, width, group, and resolution factors
